model_meta.description: Replaceable chuck system transferring motor torque through an automatically engaging interface and internal mechanical transmission to move jaws and clamp a workpiece or tool.

subsystems.description: Chuck body/housing supporting the clamping space and separately modeled translating jaws; excludes the jaws and guides.
At least two jaws guided in translation along the clamping plane toward or away from the clamping-space center.
Internal mechanical transmission including drive shafts and gearing; the described embodiment uses a splined output shaft engaging a spiral ring that drives jaws.

interfaces.interface_type: Direct drive-member to chuck torque-transfer coupling

subsystems.description: Chuck receiver on which the chuck is mounted; includes the drive member represented by MOTOR, which has the coupling element that engages the chuck torque-transfer member. The receiver mounting relationship remains distinct from the torque-transfer coupling.
External handling device, optionally a robot arm, that mounts and dismounts the chuck for replacement.

interfaces.interface_type: Handling contact for chuck dismounting and mounting
Handling interaction at chuck receiver during replacement

subsystems.description: External clamped item presented at the chuck clamping space.

Drive motor serving as the chuck receiver's drive member, optionally a servomotor. Its motor-shaft coupling element engages the chuck-side torque-transfer coupling directly; this is the drive member identified in claim 14, not a separate in-series stage.

interfaces.interface_type: Drive motor structural association with chuck receiver

item_flows.name: Drive torque
item_flows.notes: Drive-member torque crosses the direct coupling to the chuck torque-transfer member; the receiver is mounting context, not an intermediate torque stage.

item_flows.name: Jaw-drive rotation
item_flows.notes: Transmission output rotates jaw-drive mechanism to produce jaw translation.

item_flows.name: Clamping contact force
item_flows.notes: Jaw faces apply clamping force to workpiece/tool.

item_flows.name: Chuck mounting support
item_flows.notes: Mounting relation between chuck body and receiver; distinct from the direct drive-member-to-transmission torque coupling.

item_flows.name: Motor-receiver structural association
item_flows.notes: Structural association of the receiver's drive member with the chuck receiver; distinct from motor torque transfer to the chuck transmission.

item_flows.name: Handler-chuck replacement interaction
item_flows.notes: Automation device dismounts the chuck and mounts a replacement chuck.

item_flows.name: Handler-receiver replacement interaction
item_flows.notes: Replacement operation mounts/dismounts the chuck at the chuck receiver.

actions.name: Transfer drive torque to jaw mechanism

steps.description: The motor-shaft coupling element supplies torque directly through the coupling to the chuck torque-transfer member; the receiver provides chuck mounting context.
The transmission conveys drive torque to the jaw mechanism.
The transmission output drives the jaw mechanism.
The automation device dismounts the chuck from the receiver, disengaging the coupling.
The automation device mounts a replacement chuck on the receiver; the chuck coupling aligns and engages the corresponding drive-member coupling element.

actions.name: Move jaws and adjust clamping space

steps.description: The jaw mechanism moves the jaws in translation along the clamping plane, changing the clamping-space size.
Jaw faces apply clamping force to the workpiece or tool.
